title: Stored generated column
claim: Store a computed value as a generated column and index it; trades storage for query speed.
verdict: Confirmed, though in PostgreSQL an expression index does the same without storing a column. The generated column
+ index took the query from {t:expression_no_index} to {t:generated_column}
({x:expression_no_index/generated_column}), like the expression index in demo 13, but added 39 MB to a 423 MB
table (+9%) and rewrote the whole table. Use a generated column when the value is also selected or reused in
